manual_102.topic: Free garage + free car from Boobie's apartment: laptop in the bedroom, password Muffins-Queen-15, WhatUp chat from Unknown leads to a locked garage next to Auntie's Place in La Perle, keypad code 92665 unlocks Vanessa's Growler

Rockstar hid a free garage and a free car in GTA 6. In Boobie's apartment, open the bedroom laptop: the password is Muffins-Queen-15. Read the WhatUp chat from Unknown, go to the locked garage next to Auntie's Place in La Perle and enter 92665: Vanessa's Growler is yours.

GTA 6 hid PAUL WALKER'S car 💚 (don't open the trunk) | سيارة بول ووكر مخفية في GTA 6 💚

GTA 6 hides a tribute to Paul Walker: a bright green tuner like Brian's Eclipse from the first Fast & Furious, in a villa garage on Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands, just west of Vice Beach. Break the lock to get in. Then open the trunk: a snake jumps out, a Toy Story joke.

GTA 6 has a Dexter Easter egg: a waterfront block called Trinity Apartments on Washington Island in Vice City. You can't go inside, but a boat like Dexter's Slice of Life sits on the water, and up on the roof you'll find a knife, a syringe and more of his tools.
